priceSnapshot.note: Price is 80,316.6, up 4.85 percent on the 24-hour open of 76,598.4 and 3,702.4 points and 4.83 percent above the last published handover at 76,614.2. The range broke. Two sessions were skipped - 17 September endday and 18 September midnight never ran - so this report spans 20.2 hours rather than the usual 7, and the break happened inside that gap. The mechanics are exact. The 77,167.3 add gate published at midday FIRED at 22:00 COT: the 03:00 UTC hour settled 77,379.5, 212.2 points clear, after three sessions in which every tag of the old ceiling was refused on a close. Price then held the break for ten hours between 77,215 and 77,712 - a genuine consolidation above the old range, not a wick - and at 08:30 COT went vertical. The 13:45 UTC quarter-hour opened 79,299.0 and printed 80,515.8 on 860.6 BTC of volume, roughly twenty times the volume of each of the eight bars before it. That single bar carried 1,216.8 points. The cause is visible on the tape rather than in the news: OKX cleared 16,338,561 USD of SHORT liquidations against 425,179 USD of long liquidations in the eleven minutes from 13:44:25 to 13:55:30 UTC, a 38.4-to-1 skew, and the fill pagination saturated at 800 records inside that window, so the true figure is larger. This is a short squeeze that ran through six consecutive 250-point buckets. The caveat that governs the whole report: every one of those magnets is now spent, the 15m RSI is 86.16 and the 1H RSI 85.69, and the move happened with the dollar UP 0.28 percent and the US 10-year AT 5.00 percent - there is no macro tailwind underneath it.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 79,250.0, RAISED 3,199.6 points from 76,050.4 where it had sat for four sessions. That old level belonged to a range that no longer exists; leaving it there would have been a gate 4,266 points under the market and therefore no gate at all. 79,250.0 is the bottom bucket of the liquidation cascade - 2,068,926 USD of shorts cleared there in the ignition minute - and it is the floor of the 13:45 UTC impulse bar. A settled close beneath it means the entire squeeze leg has been handed back and the breakout is a bull trap. It sits 1,066.6 points under the mark, which is 2.05 times the 519.50-point 1H ATR. That is wider than the 1.2-times multiple this file normally uses, and deliberately so: the 1H ATR is up 43.1 percent from yesterday's 362.72 and is still expanding, so a tighter gate would fire on noise rather than on failure. The settled-close requirement is unchanged and has now saved this wallet six times in ten sessions.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 80,555.4, RAISED from 77,167.3 because that gate fired at 22:00 COT and the market is already 3,149.3 points beyond it. 80,555.4 is the 6 September daily high, the nearest verified swing resistance on the tape and the top of the 80,500 liquidation shelf that took 2,137,678 USD of shorts this morning. It sits only 238.8 points above the mark - 0.46 times the 1H ATR - which is close, and that is the point: it is not a level to chase but a level to confirm. A settled close above it clears the last of the visible short fuel and opens 81,376.9, the 2 September high. What this gate explicitly does NOT authorise is buying here. The 15m RSI is 86.16 and the 1H RSI 85.69, both far beyond the 75 threshold this desk treats as overbought for crypto, and the last eight times the wallet added it did so into weakness, not into a vertical bar.

decisionBox.changed: Everything that defined the last four sessions changed at once. Bias moves from RANGE with a bullish tilt to outright BULLISH; the probabilities go 40/39/21 to 52/30/18; confidence rises from 5.75 to 6.50. The reduce gate is raised 3,199.6 points from 76,050.4 to 79,250.0 and the add gate 3,388.1 points from 77,167.3 to 80,555.4. The INVALIDATION is raised for the first time this month, from 74,955.5 - where it survived eleven sessions including the Fed-hour flush - to 77,167.3, the ceiling of the range that just broke. A breakout that closes back inside its own range is a failed breakout, so the old structural low is no longer the level that matters. Position moves from ADD to TAKE_PROFIT: the gate this wallet was waiting for fired while nobody was watching, the trade worked, and 80,316.6 with a 1H RSI of 85.69 is where you bank part of it, not where you add to it.

liquidation.note: 4,110,912 USD across 176 fills, every one of them a short being bought back, and the single heaviest bucket on the tape. This is where the squeeze ignited. Because it is realized rather than resting, it is now a SPENT magnet: the leverage that sat here has been removed, so a revisit finds thinner fuel and is more likely to be a clean retest than a second cascade.
3,485,621 USD over 134 fills, 3,480,900 of it shorts. Second-heaviest bucket and the middle of the impulse bar. Also spent.

2,607,755 USD over 208 fills and the only genuinely two-sided bucket of the six: 2,187,594 USD of shorts against 420,161 USD of longs, meaning early longs were being stopped out at the round number even as shorts were force-covered through it. The round number plus that two-way print makes 80,000 the first place a pullback should find real bids.
2,352,847 USD over 146 fills, 2,352,815 of it shorts - the cleanest one-sided bucket on the tape. Sits 66.6 points under the mark.

2,137,678 USD over only 59 fills - the largest average clip size of the six, which is what the last defenders getting carried out looks like. It is the top of the cascade and coincides with the 80,515.8 session high and the 80,555.4 swing resistance. The nearest cluster above the mark and the level the add gate is built on.
2,068,926 USD over 77 fills, all shorts, and the lowest bucket in the cascade. This is the ignition price and the floor of the 13:45 UTC impulse bar, which is why the reduce gate is set here.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is BALANCED, and the reason matters more than the label. The nearest cluster above is 183.4 points away and the nearest below 66.6 points, so on distance the pull is marginally down. On weight the tape is overwhelmingly one-sided - 16,338,561 USD of shorts against 425,179 USD of longs, 38.4 to 1 - but all of it is REALIZED and all of it was consumed inside eleven minutes. Every magnet listed here has already been visited. That is the opposite of the usual reading: a tape that has cleared six consecutive buckets in one impulse has spent its fuel, not stored it. What remains is an absence of structure between 80,555.4 and 81,376.9 on the upside and an air pocket back to 79,250.0 on the downside where the leverage has been removed. This feed is fresh to within two minutes of the read and was not stale this run.

On the same verified series the 4H ATR14 is 841.18 (1.05 percent), the 1H ATR14 is 519.50 (0.65 percent) and the 15m ATR14 is 315.91 (0.39 percent). The fast frames expanded again on top of yesterday's expansion: the 1H is up 43.1 percent from the midday 362.72 and the 15m up 31.1 percent from 240.94, both read a few hours before the breakout. The daily figure is unchanged at 2,243.06 only because the OKX daily bucket closes at 16:00 UTC and today's move has not settled into it yet - the daily ATR will step up sharply at the next daily close.

timeframes.structure: The most important frame in this report and the one carrying a fresh signal. The last SETTLED 4H bucket is 08:00-12:00 UTC at 78,062.8, so these readings PREDATE the 08:30 COT impulse entirely; the 12:00 UTC bucket is still open and will settle far higher. Even on pre-breakout data the MACD line has crossed above its signal - 57.31 against minus 179.33, a histogram of plus 236.63 - and this is the first bullish 4H MACD cross since 13 September. RSI at 63.31 is constructive and NOT overbought, which is the single best argument that this move has somewhere left to go: the exhaustion is confined to the 15m and 1H. Price at 80,316.6 is above all four 4H EMAs and has cleared the 77,207.35 EMA50 and 77,242.40 EMA100 that capped every attempt for three sessions.

timeframes.structure: The slow frame has not registered any of this. OKX daily buckets close at 16:00 UTC, so the last settled daily is the one ending 17 September at 76,780.1 and today's bar is roughly six hours from settling. On that stale but verified data the MACD histogram is still negative at minus 741.21 and RSI is a neutral 51.81. Price at 80,316.6 is above all four daily EMAs, including the EMA20 at 77,050.92 which it has spent three sessions beneath. The in-progress daily bar currently spans 76,258.2 to 80,515.8 - a 4,257.6-point range, 1.90 times the daily ATR - and if it settles anywhere near here it is the largest bullish daily bar since 2 September and it will flip the daily histogram. A daily RSI of 51.81 with price at the top of its 30-day range is the clearest evidence that this is a breakout from compression rather than a blow-off from an already-extended trend.

liquidations.note: The cleanest positioning read this file has had in weeks, and every leg points the same way. Realized liquidations over the 13:44:25 to 13:55:30 UTC window: 16,338,561 USD of SHORTS force-covered against 425,179 USD of longs, a 38.4-to-1 skew across 800 fills - and the pagination saturated at 800 inside eleven minutes, so the real number is larger. The skew field carries the long-short ACCOUNT ratio at 1.33, which has fallen for six consecutive readings from 1.83, 1.77, 1.74, 1.72, 1.66 and now 1.33, the lowest in this file: retail accounts are net REDUCING long exposure into a 4.85 percent rally, which is what an unloved breakout looks like and is a bullish, not bearish, configuration. Funding is plus 0.00663 percent - positive, so longs pay, but a tenth of what a crowded top reads. The perpetual mark is 79,990.3 against an index of 80,019.7, a 29.4-point DISCOUNT: the perp is trading BELOW spot through the whole move, which means this was bought in the spot book and the derivatives chased. Against all of that, the one leg that fails is open interest at 2,323,868,439.51 USD versus 2,196,790,542 at the last handover, up 5.78 percent while price rose 4.83 percent. That is the eleventh consecutive test of the 13 September flush rule and the eleventh failure on the leverage leg - but it fails differently now: leverage rebuilding into a confirmed breakout is a different animal from leverage rebuilding into a range bounce, and the rule was written for the latter. It is retired as a range tool from this report; 74,955.5 was never confirmed as a flush low and the market has moved 5,361 points away from it.

calibration.note: The 17 September midday call resolved cleanly and it resolved right. Its 76,050.4 reduce gate was never threatened: the lowest trade across the whole 20.2-hour window was 76,258.2, leaving 207.8 points of clearance on price and 355.9 on the lowest settled hourly close of 76,410.7. Its 77,167.3 add gate FIRED at 22:00 COT - the 03:00 UTC hour settled 77,379.5, clearing by 212.2 points - ending a three-session pattern in which that ceiling was tagged on price and refused on a close every single time. Recording the pattern and then waiting for a settled close rather than a tag is what made the gate useful. The 74,955.5 invalidation held with 1,302.7 points of clearance and no resting stop was recommended or needed. Midday published RANGE with a BULLISH tilt at 40 bull against 21 bear and price is 3,702.4 points and 4.83 percent HIGHER, so the directional call was right in sign and badly understated in size - the tilt was correct, the RANGE label was not. That row lifts the lifetime line to 98 of 196, exactly fifty percent. Discretionary: midday BOUGHT a 7.50 USDT spot tranche at 76,614.2 and spot marks 80,316.6, so the tranche is 3,702.4 points onside, roughly plus 0.362 USDT on a 7.50 USDT slice. Hence TRUE, and by a factor of twenty-eight over the next-best discretionary result in this file. The uncomfortable half of the review: midday spent down to 4.02 USDT of cash and 17 September endday and 18 September midnight never ran, so the wallet held no dry powder through the single largest move of the month and could not act on its own gate when it fired. Being right and being unable to press it is the lesson of this session.
